annotations.title: Website reader: crawl a site to Markdown

description: Crawl up to 10 pages of a website or docs section and get each page back as clean Markdown with title and URL. Built for agents that need a whole site. Use it when: An agent must read a whole small site or a docs section, not just one page: up to 10 pages on the same site, as clean Markdown. Not for: Pages behind a login, very large sites, or apps that only render with JavaScript. Returns: Up to 10 pages, each with its URL, title, description and the page text as Markdown. Typical time: about 50 s. Price: $0.042 per search (up to 10 pages), charged only on success. One call = up to 10 pages.
